start.welcome:
👋 Welcome to ShopBot!

Sell on Telegram with your own mini shop — no website needed.

What would you like to do?
start.customer_hint: To shop, open the link a shop shared with you — it looks like t.me/{bot}?start=shopname
start.unknown_shop: 😕 That shop link doesn't exist. Please check the link and try again.
start.shop_closed: ⏸ {shop} is temporarily closed. Please check back later.
onb.name:
🏪 {step}

What is your shop's name?
onb.name_invalid: Please send a name between 2 and 80 characters.
onb.desc:
📝 {step}

Describe your shop in one or two sentences (what you sell, where you are).
onb.desc_invalid: Please send a short description (up to 300 characters).
onb.phone:
📞 {step}

Send your shop's phone number. Customers will call this number.
onb.phone_invalid: That doesn't look like a phone number. Example: 0911223344
onb.done: 🎉 Your shop {shop} is ready! 🔗 Your shop link: {link} 🆓 Free trial until {date}. Next: add your first product.
onb.resume: 👋 Let's finish setting up your shop.
paused.owner:
⏸ Your shop is paused.

To continue, send *ETB {price}* to:
{account}

Then tap *💳 Subscription* and send the payment screenshot.
prod.send_photo:
📸 Send a photo of the product.

💡 Tip: add a caption like *Red Shoes - 1200* to skip the next two steps.
prod.need_photo: Please send a photo (not a file).
prod.name: ✏️ What is the product name?
prod.price_invalid: Please send a number, e.g. 1200 or 99.50
prod.stock:
📦 How many in stock?
Send a number, or tap *Unlimited*.
prod.stock_invalid: Please send a whole number (0 or more).
prod.category: 🏷 Choose a category, or create a new one.
prod.list_title:
📦 *Products* ({n})

Tap a product to view or edit it.
prod.list_empty:
📦 No products yet.

Tap *➕ Add product* to add your first one — it takes 30 seconds.
prod.desc_prompt: 📝 Send a short description (or tap Skip to clear it).
share.text: 🔗 Share your shop Send this link to customers or post it anywhere: {link} Or let them scan the QR code above.
share.forward: Forward this message to your customers 👇
err.generic: 😕 Something went wrong. Please try again.
order.status_pending: ⏳ Pending — waiting for the shop to confirm
order.status_confirmed: ✅ Confirmed — the shop is preparing your order
order.err_product_unavailable: One of the products is no longer available.
order.err_out_of_stock: Not enough stock for one of the products.
app.no_products: 🧺 Nothing here yet — check back soon.
app.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 0911223344
app.shop_will_confirm: The shop will confirm shortly. You'll get updates in this chat.
app.upload_later: I'll send it later in chat
app.closed_text: {shop} is not taking orders right now. Please check back later.
app.offline: Check your connection and try again.
app.not_in_telegram: Please open this shop from Telegram.
ord.list_empty: Nothing here yet. New orders will appear in this chat automatically.
ord.reject_reason:
❌ Rejecting order #{code}.

Send a short reason for the customer, or tap Skip.
cust.orders_empty: 🧾 You have no orders here yet.
cust.send_proof: 📎 Please send the payment screenshot as a photo.
cust.proof_received: ✅ Screenshot received — the shop will confirm your payment.
cust.proof_which: 📎 Which order is this screenshot for?
cust.invalid_phone: That doesn't look like a phone number. Example: 0911223344
cust.invalid_address: Please send a delivery address (at least 3 characters).
cust.out_of_stock_removed: ⚠️ {name} is out of stock and was removed from your cart.
ai.ask_prompt: ❓ Ask anything about *{shop}* — prices, delivery, availability. Amharic or English.
ai.forwarded: 📨 I'm not sure about that, so I've sent your question to the shop. They'll reply here.
ai.rate_limited: ⏳ Too many questions right now. Please contact the shop directly: {phone}
ai.disabled: 💬 The assistant is off for this shop. Contact the shop: {phone}
ai.error: 😕 I couldn't answer right now. Please try again or contact the shop: {phone}
subs.send_proof: 📎 Send the payment screenshot as a photo. Include the amount and your shop name if possible.
subs.proof_sent: ✅ Thank you! We'll confirm your payment shortly and extend your access.
subs.approved: 🎉 Payment confirmed! Your shop is active until {until}.
subs.paused:
⏸ Your shop has been paused.{reason}

To continue: send ETB {price} to {account}, then tap 💳 Subscription → I paid.
subs.resumed: ▶️ Your shop is active again. Welcome back!
subs.expiring:
⏰ Your access to ShopBot ends in {days} days ({until}).

Send ETB {price} to {account} and tap 💳 Subscription → I paid to keep your shop open.
subs.expired:
⏸ Your trial/subscription has ended and your shop is paused.

Send ETB {price} to {account}, then tap 💳 Subscription → I paid.
subs.rejected: ❌ We couldn't verify your payment. Please check the amount and account, then send the screenshot again.
adm.help:
🛠 *Admin*

/admin shops [page]
/admin shop <id>
/admin approve <id> <months>
/admin extend <id> <days>
/admin pause <id> [reason]
/admin resume <id>
/admin stats
/admin broadcast <text>
adm.payment_card:
💳 *Payment claim* from shop #{id} *{name}* ({owner}, `{owner_id}`)
Current access until: {until}
